target_customer: Self-insured employers paying for employee healthcare
problem: Employers overpay for procedures and tests; CareLedger picked in-network providers with fair prices and aimed to make care free to employees, charging employers only on savings.
business_model: Employer-paid, savings-based fee (employer pays only when costs are lowered)

founders.name: Oliver Takach
founders.background_notes: YC page bio. Education not found.

founders.name: Klaus Mergener
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him with no bio.

founders.name: Nik Swain
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as Founder/CTO with no bio.

exit.reason: Not public. YC and Tracxn list it as inactive or deadpooled; no announcement found.

competitors.name: HealthSparq
competitors.what: Health plan price and provider comparison tools

technical_complexity.rationale: Needed provider price data on 600 plus procedures, scheduling and employer integration; mostly data and operations work.

defensibility.rationale: Price data and provider networks could be assembled by others, and employer sales cycles favored incumbents.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No evidence of incumbents copying it; the company went quiet after 2015.

market_need_then: TechCrunch in July 2015 reported claims of up to 50 percent savings on over 600 procedures, and the YC launch post framed free care for employees. Regulatory and insurer price transparency efforts were growing in 2015.

branding.domain_note: careledger.com was later resold per Internet Archive captures cited in a search summary; the host did not resolve from this session.

brand_strength.rationale: No brand coverage found; the name is descriptive and the same name is used by unrelated products (a 2018 trademark filing, an NDIS platform, an iOS app).

outcome_analysis: The cause of CareLedger's end is not public. It raised the standard YC amount in August 2015 per one database and no later rounds were found; YC and Tracxn list it as inactive. Without a post-mortem or announcement no failure factor can be assigned, and the record only supports that it did not progress beyond the seed stage.
notes: Round rests on CB Insights alone (listed $120K over up to 3 rounds; Social Starts participation unconfirmed). The YC launch post names no competitors; competitors come from a 2015 eVisit infographic seen as a search result only. careledger.com did not resolve from this session, so site status is unknown, though a search summary says the domain was resold. Founders from YC page only.
